szoveg_eredeti:
One of the coolest recent features in Pi is Virtual Models

I am using it to route to Qwen 3.8 27B (running locally in llama.cpp ) or to Kimi K3 or GLM 5.3 (hosted remotely), depending on my query complexity and my machine(s)' current load 🔥

No more manual model switching!!

Simple question? Stay local. Tricky architecture problem? Go remote. Mac already busy? Make it easier to choose the hosted model.

The fun detail: local Qwen classifies the query’s complexity (using Llama.cpp 's Classifier API mode). But when the machine is heavily congested, the router skips that step and goes straight to GLM.

All implemented as a small Pi extension. One model selected (`hybrid/auto`), two backends.

Kudos to Mario Zechner and Armin Ronacher , and of course the ggml team, for making this possible 👍
